title: Burstwise → PTO Import
text: This tool packages legacy burst analysis folders (bi4_bur, bg4, br4, Info, .mti) into standardized .mmfdb.pto containers.

title: Select analysis folder
text: Enter or browse for a legacy burstwise folder. Folders can also be dragged and dropped directly onto the window.

title: Scan folder contents
text: Click Scan to discover measurement stems, companion tables, Info settings, and folder-name parameters.

title: Source resolution
text: Choose how raw TTTR files are located: by re-mapping original paths from .mti or by checking for files with matching stems beside the folder.

title: Convert to PTO
text: Click Run to convert detected measurements into .mmfdb.pto containers.

title: Review results
text: The results pane lists written .mmfdb.pto containers and flags any columns that could not be mapped to the dictionary.
